THE LEARNING LOOP

Evidence, not activity

Flashcard taps cannot manufacture fluency.
1Meet

Meaning, sound, article, plural, and one natural context.

2Retrieve

Produce the word without answer choices or a visible model.

3Transfer

Use it inside a new sentence while grammar and meaning compete.

4Return later

Only delayed success can move vocabulary toward durable.

YOUR WORD MODEL

Vocabulary by evidence

A word can be familiar without being available in speech. These tiers deliberately separate exposure from durable retrieval.

0words encountered
Introduced Practicing Retrievable Durable
German bundleMeaningTierEvidenceNext useful action
No words in this tier yet.
Why retries barely move the meter

Recognition and same-session repetition are useful practice, but they are weak evidence of durable recall. Reliable and durable tiers require production across later sessions and different contexts.

LANGUAGE IN PEOPLE'S LIVES

Context, without stereotypes

Culture notes explain choices you may actually face. They are invitations to notice variation, not rules for how every German behaves.

01 · ADDRESS

Du or Sie?

du signals familiarity; Sie creates respectful distance. In workplaces and new relationships, the choice depends on the setting rather than one universal rule. When unsure, listening first is often safer than assuming.

duSieWie heißen Sie?
Goethe-Institut source ↗
02 · REGIONS

One greeting is never the whole map

Hallo travels well, but regional speech is part of daily life. You may hear Moin in the north and Servus or Grüß Gott farther south.

MoinServusGuten Tag
Deutschland.de source ↗
03 · METHOD

Culture is something you investigate

Good cultural learning goes beyond memorizing national facts. It asks learners to observe, compare, discuss, and revise their assumptions about German-speaking communities.

DeutschlandÖsterreichdie Schweiz
Goethe-Institut source ↗

CREDITS & SOURCES

Where the system gets its footing

Satzwerk’s wording and exercises are original synthesis. These sources guide level definitions, vocabulary scope, grammar checks, learning design, and cultural context.

LEVEL FRAMEWORK

Council of Europe · CEFR Companion Volume

Used to frame communicative competencies and the A1–B2 pathway. CEFR levels are not reduced to vocabulary totals.

Open source ↗
VOCABULARY SCOPE

Goethe-Institut · Deutsch Online A1 glossary

Used as one reference for beginner vocabulary selection and for the practice of storing nouns with their articles, plurals, and examples.

GRAMMAR

Duden and IDS Grammis

Used to verify noun categories, case behavior, and the local-versus-directional contrast of German two-way prepositions.

LEARNING SCIENCE

Retrieval practice and spacing research

The distinction between immediate practice and durable evidence is informed by research on test-enhanced learning and distributed practice.

Roediger & Karpicke ↗Cepeda et al. ↗

Goethe-Institut and Deutschland.de
